claims.head: The Sharks don’t own Hofer
claims.body: Since 2023-24, Hofer has been shaky against the Sharks, well below his usual. Fans love a pattern like this, but we checked three seasons of them and they predicted nothing. Don’t be surprised if he’s back to his usual self.

claims.gist: Don’t read much into Hofer’s record against the Sharks.
